name: Trimmer potentiometer
description: A small square trimmer (trimpot) that you adjust with a screwdriver and then leave alone, e.g. to set a contrast or a threshold. Like a potentiometer it is two resistors VCC–SIG and SIG–GND that add up to its resistance: SIG gives a voltage between GND and VCC. Drag the screw round (also while the simulation runs). The code on top is the value: 103 = 10 × 10³ Ω = 10 kΩ.
